Alfa Romeo 156 GTA - An Italian masterpiece in as-new condition

Featured cars
One of the most sought-after versions of the Alfa Romeo 156 has found its way to Bidders Highway. A Sportwagon GTA with manual gearbox, fully restored to near-new condition and ready to offer its next owner equal parts passion and performance.
Tomas JönssonAugust 15, 2025 12:20

A tribute to the marque's racing heritage

When Alfa Romeo launched the 156 GTA at the Frankfurt Motor Show in 2001, it was a clear nod to the brand's classic Gran Turismo Alleggerita models from the 1960s – cars built to be both fast and light. Designer Walter de'Silva gave the 156 a sporty, elegant silhouette with coupé-like lines and hidden rear door handles, and the GTA version received wider wheel arches, a lower profile and a more aggressive stance.

But it's under the bonnet where the magic happens. Here pulses the legendary 3.2-litre Busso V6 engine, hand-assembled at Maserati's facilities in Modena. With 250 horsepower and 300 Nm of torque, it delivers performance matched by an engine note few cars can rival – a deep, song-like roar that has made the Busso a legend in the car world.

One of few Sportwagons with manual gearbox

This is not just any 156 GTA. It's a Sportwagon with a manual gearbox – a combination produced in very limited numbers and today highly sought after among enthusiasts. With this car you get the practical body style combined with the pure, direct driving feel that only a manual gearbox can provide.

This car also carries a unique history. Between 2022 and 2024, the current owner has had the car undergo a complete, professional restoration. Everything has been replaced or restored, from engine and drivetrain to paint and interior, and the work has been carried out to – or in many cases beyond – the manufacturer's specifications. The result is a car that not only looks and feels new, but also carries the peace of mind of being in perfect condition, with full documentation.

Performance for those who want to drive

Beneath the surface, the V6's power is matched by a chassis built to deliver driving pleasure. The quicker steering rack provides direct responses, the Brembo brakes deliver substantial stopping power, and the suspension – double wishbone at the front and MacPherson at the rear – keeps the car stable even when the road gets twisty. 0–100 km/h takes just over six seconds and top speed is around 250 km/h, but it's the journey there that is the real reward.

An opportunity that rarely comes again

Finding an Alfa Romeo 156 GTA Sportwagon in good condition is difficult. Finding one with a manual gearbox, perfectly restored and in flawless condition, is nearly unique. It offers something rare in today's car world – a combination of practical usability and pure, unadulterated driving pleasure.

For the collector, this is a chance to secure one of the most coveted examples of Alfa Romeo's modern era. For the driver, it's an opportunity to experience how Italian engineering, design and passion come together in one single car. The auction is now open – the only question is who will have the honour of turning the key next.
